title: Head of Majors, Developer GTM
description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: SF Bay Area About Cloudflare At Cloudflare, our mission is bold yet simple: to help build a better Internet. Our global network handles trillions of requests each month, protecting and accelerating applications without added hardware, software, or code changes. Our Developer Platform, including Workers, Workers AI, R2, KV, Durable Objects, and Pages, empowers developers to build and deploy applications globally, faster than ever before. About the Team The Developer GTM organization is driving how we attract, inspire, and grow the next generation of builders. We are redefining what developer acquisition looks like in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to lead the transformation of Cloudflare GTM into a Cloud Platform that has roots and capabilities in application services and cybersecurity. We create new pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare, whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement and enablement. We are builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the best place for developers to build. The Developer GTM organization partners tightly with Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, RevOps, and Marketing. Developer GTM connects developer activation to durable commercial outcomes: shaping usage into clear proposals, aligning pricing and packaging, enabling the field with repeatable motions, and feeding real-world signals back into Product. About the Role Majors are Cloudflare's most important accounts, representing the world’s largest technology organizations. These are companies with thousands of engineers, massive production footprints, and infrastructure decisions that move markets. When a major account adopts Cloudflare's Developer Platform at scale, the commercial impact is outsized and durable. Winning here requires a highly strategic, technically fluent GTM leader. As the Head of Majors, you will own Cloudflare's Developer Platform GTM strategy for our most critical enterprise segment. This is the deepest, most strategic end of the Developer GTM spectrum. Fewer accounts, higher stakes, longer cycles, and more complex stakeholder maps. You will set the strategy for how Cloudflare earns and grows Developer Platform adoption inside these accounts, lead engagement with their most senior technical and commercial leaders, and work with the field to structure deals that match the scale and sophistication of how these companies build. We are looking for a seasoned enterprise sales leader who brings deep experience selling into or managing relationships and driving revenue within large, complex technology companies. You understand how to navigate organizations with layers of engineering leadership, procurement, security review, and legal. You can build a multi-year account strategy and execute against it with patience and precision. And you bring the developer fluency to engage credibly with CTOs and VPs of Engineering on workload architecture, not just commercial terms. What You Will Do Define the Majors GTM strategy: Build the operating model for how Cloudflare wins, grows, and retains Developer Platform adoption in its largest accounts. Set performance goals, scorecards, and cadences, defining success at both the account and portfolio levels. Architect Multi-Year Account Strategies: Build and execute comprehensive Developer Platform plans for priority accounts: defining target workloads, how adoption acceleration paths, competitive positioning, and the commercial path to get there. Command Executive Engagement: Build trusted relationships with CTOs, CIOs, VPs of Infrastructure, and VPs of Engineering, as well as the commercial decision-makers at these accounts. Run impactful executive business reviews and bring Cloudflare leadership into the conversation at the right moments. Structure Complex & Strategic Deals: Work with the account executive, Deal Desk, Pricing, Finance, and Legal to design bespoke commit structures and consumption-based agreements that match how major accounts actually build. Compete credibly against hyperscalers and other platforms at the largest scale. Accelerate Activation & Expansion: Leverage usage telemetry to identify next-best actions, expansion paths, and risks.
